picks.catalyst: In-session: the Anthropic IPO is being priced by the market this morning and Amazon is the largest outside holder. 06:38 the amended S-1 set 801M shares at $70-78; 09:55 the Financial Times reported Goldman Sachs expects Anthropic revenue to exceed $600B by 2030 (Amazon already booked a $50.5B upward adjustment on its Anthropic preferred in Q2, so the IPO marks that stake again); Amazon also announced its Black Friday Week events (06:32). The tape agrees: AMZN 266.33 open -> 271.70 at 10:17 (+2.0% from the open, +1.8% on the day, high 272.88 minutes ago) while SPY is +0.3% from its open and the 'Anthropic beneficiaries' (AMD +5.9% from open on its $2.5B IPO investment, TSM +2.3% on its Anthropic/OpenAI investments, MU +1.9%) lead; internet theme neutral with REL_STRONG + BREADTH_UP. Within the 3% line, reported 10-29 (no window). Risks: platforms were sold intraday Monday (AMZN -0.9% open to close), the hot CPI has yields up (TLT -1.3%) which taxes long duration, and the 11-02 AMZN lesson (picked at +4% from open, topped minutes later). Shadow-only sample since 2026-11-09 (catalyst_intraday real_risk 0; the hero shadow takes the full ledger).
